{{Infobox |eng = Scarecrow |source = [[Crafting]] |season = [[Spring]] • [[Summer]] • [[Fall]] |recipe = [[File:Farming Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Farming]] Level 1 |ingredients = {{Name|Wood|50}}{{Name|Coal|1}}{{Name|Fiber|20}} |sellprice = Cannot be sold }} A '''Scarecrow''' is a craftable item that prevents [[Animals#Crows|crows]] from eating [[crops]]. Scarecrows can be crafted at [[Farming]] level 1. Scarecrows are not needed to protect crops grown from [[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds]], since crows do not attack them. Since there are no crows on [[Ginger Island]], no scarecrows need to be planted on the farm there. ==Range== A Scarecrow will protect the surrounding circular area of 249 spaces (including the space its standing on); 8 spaces each to the north, east, south, and west, as well as 6 spaces each to the northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest. In other words, it protects a 17x17 area, excluding 10 spaces in each corner. [[File:Scarecrow Range.png|500px]] ==Rarecrows== '''Rarecrows''' work the same way as regular Scarecrows, except for the Alien Scarecrow, which hats can be placed on. Soon after collecting all 8 rarecrows (usually the next day) a letter will arrive with the recipe to craft a [[Deluxe Scarecrow]]. {|class="wikitable" ! Number ! Image !
